title: Business — Platform usage
description: Datasets, users, downloads, uploads, searches and DOIs.

options.content: Counts over the time range picked above. Totals (datasets, users, DOIs, storage) come from the database at scrape time, so they are right even for what happened before metrics existed. Per-user and per-dataset panels read the access logs.

panels.title: Distinct users per day
panels.description: Users the webapp acted for, from the gatekeeper's access log.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({container=~"datamap_gatekeeper.*", logger="http.access"} | json | user_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Most viewed datasets in range
panels.description: By dataset id: the access log carries the path, not the name.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (path) (count_over_time({container=~"datamap_gatekeeper.*", logger="http.access"} | json | method="GET" | route="/api/v1/datasets/{id}" | status_code="200" [$__range])))
sum by (design_state, visibility) (max by (tenancy, design_state, visibility) (datamap_datasets{tenancy=~"$tenancy"}))

panels.title: Bytes behind issued links, by tenancy
Download funnel in range
panels.description: Completed downloads are on the Nginx dashboard: only nginx sees the bytes leave.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(increase(datamap_http_requests_total{job="gatekeeper", method="GET", route="/api/v1/datasets/{id}", status="200"}[$__range])), "step", "1 dataset page views", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(datamap_web_ui_events_total{event="download_clicked"}[$__range])), "step", "2 download clicks", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(datamap_download_urls_issued_total[$__range])), "step", "3 links issued", "", "")

panels.title: Upload funnel in range
panels.description: A drop between 3 and 4 is the post-finish hook failing: see UploadHooksFailing.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(increase(datamap_web_ui_events_total{event="upload_started"}[$__range])), "step", "1 started in the browser", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(tusd_uploads_created[$__range])), "step", "2 received by tusd", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(tusd_uploads_finished[$__range])), "step", "3 finished in tusd", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(datamap_uploads_completed_total[$__range])), "step", "4 recorded on a dataset", "", "")

panels.title: Searches that found nothing
panels.description: High means people look for data that is not there, or cannot find what is.

panels.title: Email by outcome
panels.description: Sent, retried, failed and skipped messages, by template.

panels.title: Email waiting to be sent
panels.description: Messages pending or due for a retry. Growing means the dispatch is not running or SMTP is refusing.
